instruction: I need Vim to wrap long lines visually rather than scrolling horizontally. Please search online for how to enable line wrapping in Vim and configure it as a permanent setting for my local Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_wrap__9fe3f2ae.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set wrap" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Line Wrapping Configured!"
else
    echo "Line wrap not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_wrap__9fe3f2ae.sh
